developer: UET Construction (EPC/co-developer) + AL-BINA (sales & marketing partner) + IMAN Holding (financing partner)

developer: BI Group (Kazakh developer, self-described #1 developer in Central Asia)
location: New Tashkent (district within the 6,000 ha first-phase zone)

notes: Second confirmed large-scale residential developer active in New Tashkent (after UET/Crystal Avenue). Majority shareholder/chairman: Oydin Rahimboyev. developer: Sharq Bahori (developer name matches project name; featured with its own logo in the New Tashkent Directorate's official site header, suggesting flagship/showcase status)
location: New Tashkent, ~100m from a planned metro station
status: On sale / pre-sale (per developer's own site)
scale: Two phases; smart-home residential ('15-minute city' positioning)
estimated_timeline: Not determinable - no explicit delivery date published
notes: Smart-home features: Zigbee protocol home automation, face-ID entry, license-plate recognition parking. Finishes mentioned: laminate parquet, ceramic finishes, German-standard windows/joinery, XPS insulation - a concrete, if modest-scale, materials-specification opportunity.

project_name: Alisher Navoi International Scientific Research Centre

notes: Flagship cultural/institutional building, not residential - relevant mainly as a landmark prescription opportunity (public interiors, facades) rather than a sample-apartment/show-flat opportunity.
